card.line: The Habor was a river in Gozan, in Assyria, where the king of Assyria settled Israelites after he carried them away from their land.

moments.title: Israel exiled to the Habor
moments.text: After three years, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried the Israelites away. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.

moments.title: Why Israel was exiled
moments.text: The Bible says this happened because Israel did not listen to the LORD their God. They broke His covenant and would neither listen nor obey.

moments.title: Eastern tribes taken to Habor
moments.text: God stirred up the spirit of the king of Assyria to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan.
